Domain Use Cases

Real-world applications for each of the 16 Odu domains

Each domain in Ifá-Lang provides specific capabilities. This page shows practical use cases for every domain.

I/O & System

Irosu (4)

Console I/O: print, println, read input, read number, clear screen, flush, error

Interactive CLI
Build command-line tools with prompts and formatted output
Logging
Print messages with fo/println and errors with kigbe/error
View examples

Odi (3)

File I/O: read file, write file, check existence

Config Files
Read/write application configuration
Data Persistence
Save and load data from files
View examples

Ogbe (0)

Version info

Version Checks
Get Ifá-Lang version string
View examples

Oyeku (1)

Process control: exit, sleep

Timed Operations
Add delays between operations with sleep
Graceful Exit
Exit program with proper status codes
View examples
